How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. For the contiguous U.S., delivery after shipping is estimated at 1–3 days on the West Coast, 3–4 days in the Central U.S., 4–5 days in the Midwest, and 5–7 days on the East Coast. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
You can find the latest time frames on our Shipping & Delivery page.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
We offer a 90-day manufacturer’s warranty for items bought directly from us. If an item arrives with defective or broken parts, or parts break during assembly, we provide replacement parts free of charge—there’s no need to return the item. Damage from misuse or negligence isn’t covered, and purchases from third-party sellers follow those sellers’ policies.
You can read the details on our Manufacturer’s Warranty page or submit a warranty claim.
